title: Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate – Privacy collection notice
summary: This notice explains what personal and health information Service NSW collects when you apply for the Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate.
what_you_need: Your name, signature, and contact information
The name and signature of the other patient (partner or gamete donor), if applicable
Information given in the rebate form about relevant pre-IVF testing
Receipts for relevant patient related to the rebate claim

more_info.text: you can access and seek correction of the information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made.
Apply for the Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate
Read the Service NSW privacy statement for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2-24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

faqs.q: What information is collected when applying for the rebate?
faqs.a: Information collected includes your name, signature, contact details, date of birth, identity document details, banking details, and details about the relevant pre-IVF testing and receipts.

faqs.q: Do I need to provide test results?
faqs.a: No, the application does not request test results.

faqs.q: How will my information be used?
faqs.a: Your information may be used to process payments, verify identity documents, manage complaints, conduct audits, and evaluate the program.
